mapper.insert: insert into payment_history(user_id, room_id, price, payment_date, room_history_id) values(#{userId}, #{roomId}, #{price}, #{paymentDate}, #{roomHistoryId})
mapper.select: select id, user_id, room_id, price, payment_date, room_history_id from payment_history where user_id = #{userId} order by payment_date desc
mapper.update: update payment_history set price = #{price} where room_history_id = #{roomHistoryId}
